scenario: A bare string literal as the first statement of a schema body is a docstring per LGRA.12.8.1 — not a slot declaration. Pin: schema with docstring first, then slots compiles cleanly with the docstring preserved as metadata.
rules_ds:
schema Device scope logical:
    """A connected device with state and location."""
    entity_id: String key
    state: String mutable

rule r:
    Device
->
    log info "x"
